status: preregistered before implementation; not a forecast
control: frozen current B engine, same-machine same-window as candidate
formal_window: R4 protocol in optimization.mdx; no replacement of the fixed Kuzu goal

intermediate_significant_gain.stability: pooled P50 and median of three independent-process P50s must meet each threshold; report all processes and P95, no outlier removal
intermediate_significant_gain.baseline: new candidate vs concurrent frozen B, eight primary queries

rationale: Qualified medium all-node exclusive supply is 57.17%; even 2x supply gives only 1.40x end-to-end. A 1.5x all-node target thus requires more than merely halving this boundary, or additional work reductions outside it. Overall 1.5x prevents isolated-query wins being marketed as substantial. Holdout is an independent requirement, not predicted by the medium model.
stop_conditions: No callback or value replay after partial delivery; no relaxed authentication, snapshot, cancellation or budgets.
If deterministic counts show work moved rather than eliminated, retain failure and redesign before stage acceptance.
R4 misses any of the eight Kuzu P50 targets or has unresolved reproducible material P95 regression: no 100%.
If material performance, write, memory or space regressions are reproducible, fix them or apply only the adoption restrictions frozen before implementation; no post-hoc scope narrowing.
limitations: Thresholds are objectives, not statistical proof or guaranteed achievable outcomes. Percentile instability requires review under the existing protocol; tail cause and internal supply breakdown remain unresolved.
